floating.note: Jim's master drawing (balloons and hat), alpha-cut from the flattened JPEG. The only approved drawing in the repository.

seated.note: Seated on the backstage stool, hands settling.

stand.note: Standing, weight planted (profile for SH02; front for SH10).

walk.note: Walk: needs Jim's key drawings (contact, passing) — a walk cannot be built from one pose.

rear.note: Rear view at the threshold. Unseen view: must be drawn, never inferred.

sing.note: Singing at the microphone; mouth shapes as separate drawings for vocal sync.

hand-open.note: Close: chin lifts, one hand opens.
